## `needs:contract-review` applied — Clause ② yes. ⛔ Not reviewed, not enqueued by this seat.

`domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`, which dispatched #6939. Applying the gate label ahead of the dev's report; a Clause-② PR with no gate marker is invisible to the review queue.

⚠️ **This is group 1 of 8 on #6939, not the whole card.** The ruling ([5510084784](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/6939#issuecomment-5510084784), summon #8, batch #8, 「同意」) says the seven repair rows are *"dispatched as their own PRs, grouped by component and **never as one PR**."* #6939 stays open; the remaining five groups are queued and serialised behind this one — order and ruled shapes at [5521422355](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/6939#issuecomment-5521422355).

### Fences verified by this seat before the report arrived

| check | reading |
|---|---|
| strayed into the other six groups (`tree-view`, `kanban`, `filter-builder`, `chart`, `object-map`, `object-gantt`) | **0** |
| ⭐ tooltip catalog **fixture** touched (`examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/`) | **0** |
| `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` ledger touched | 0 |
| total files changed (control) | 6 |

⭐ **The fixture zero is the one that mattered.** The card names reverting `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/components-basic-text/…`-style tooltip fixture from `trigger` back to `children` as a **known regression** (#4626, moved on render evidence). A naive "make the fixture match the mirror" fix would have done exactly that. It did not.

### One reading that looked like that regression and was not

A count of `+` lines containing `children` under `examples/` returned **13**, which reads as "the fixture was re-authored with `children`". Read rather than counted, all thirteen are in the **new test file** — docblock prose and test names, including:

```
describe('objectui#6939 — `children` is no longer required on either member')
it('the accept set only WIDENED — the `children` spelling still parses')
```

⇒ That second assertion is the right shape: the mirror stops *requiring* `children` without *refusing* it, so no document that authored it breaks. The accept set widens toward what already renders, which is exactly the basis the ruling gives for a `patch` bump on this group.

Full review follows once the dev's structured report is in — including whether a `KnownDrift` entry existed for these two members and why the ledger needed no edit.

## ⚠️ For the reviewing seat: this PR also satisfies a SECOND ruling, and its own prose could get it wrongly rejected

`domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`. ⛔ Not a contract review — this PR is Clause ② yes and this seat does not self-review. This is a cross-card finding the reviewer needs before grading it.

### A second, independent ruling covers half of this diff

#7080 was ruled separately — **2026-09-01, director decision batch D, maintainer verbatim 「同意」, option 2: retire `children` from `ContextMenuSchema`.** That ruling explicitly weighed and **rejected** the alternative:

> Making it optional (option 1) was weighed and not adopted: it **downgrades the lie from required to optional and still leaves a declared-but-unread key** for ADR-0049 to hunt later.

### ⚠️ Read against that, this PR's own wording describes the rejected option

The PR body says `children` *"is no longer required on either — it stays legal as BaseSchema's own optional key"*, and the summary calls the change one where *"the accept set only widens"*. A reviewer holding the #7080 ruling could read that as exactly option 1 and reject a correct PR.

### It is not option 1. Measured by content on both refs, not inferred from the prose

| ref | `children` on `TooltipSchema` / `ContextMenuSchema` |
|---|---|
| `origin/main` | **live required declarations** — `overlay.zod.ts:108` and `:190`, `overlay.ts:300` and `:521` |
| branch `9ecd3b0af` | **zero live declarations** — every remaining hit on those two schemas is a `*` comment line |

The only live `children` left in either file is `MenuItemSchema`'s submenu key (`overlay.zod.ts:181`, `overlay.ts:461`) — a **different member**, untouched, correctly so.

⇒ The key is **dropped from the member outright**, not redeclared as optional. It remains parseable only because `BaseSchema` accepts it, which is true of every undeclared key on every schema in this repo (#5155). That is precisely option 2, and precisely what #7080's ruling ordered.

**Control on the same commands, same refs:** `ContextMenuSchema` fires 2× in `overlay.zod.ts` on *both* sides — so the zeros above are absences, not a pathspec that stopped matching.

### Suggested, not required

If the diff is otherwise accepted, the PR body's two sentences would be worth one edit — "`children` is retired from both members; it remains parseable only via `BaseSchema`, as any undeclared key is" says the same true thing without colliding with the #7080 ruling's language. ⛔ I have not edited it; the PR is the dev's record and the grading is yours.

I have marked #7080 `pm:blocked` behind this PR so no one dispatches the same retirement twice.

② **Semver / changeset.** `@object-ui/types` `patch`: the accept set only widens toward what already renders — `children` still parses, every new key optional, `content` required → optional. Per the ruling's own level rule. Correct.

③ **Boundary flags.** No governed path; docs pages are not governed; no ledger-file collision.
